summary: Backend-only testing of CleanTec Magazzino module (detergenti/DPI) + regression. 107/107 tests passing (81 previous regression + 26 new magazzino). All features requested verified: CRUD, computed flags (scorta_stato, scadenza_stato, in_allarme), /allarmi aggregate, atomic $inc movimenti (carico/scarico/rettifica), movimento history, RBAC (_WRITE_ROLES vs _MOV_ROLES), dashboard KPI magazzino_allarmi=4, audit log entries.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/magazzino.py scarico allows stock to go negative (no guard); backend only logs warning. Seed note confirms this is intentional ('warning only'), but main agent should decide if 400 should be returned when scorta_dopo<0.

_compute_flags normalises naive datetimes to UTC via replace(tzinfo=utc) but only if it has 'replace' attr; this works for both Mongo-returned naive datetimes and tz-aware now_utc(). Verified safe across seeded items.

Movimento endpoint reads articolo BEFORE $inc then computes scorta_dopo from pre-read value — under concurrent writes scorta_dopo in the movement log may diverge from the actual atomic post-value. Low-risk but worth noting.
test_credentials: All roles from /app/memory/test_credentials.md working (admin, produzione, logistica, qualita, contabilita, cliente).
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_MAG_001, TEST_DEL_001 items and clean up via DELETE in fixture teardown. No seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: 107 backend tests green. backend_test.py has regression suite (81 tests). test_magazzino.py adds 26 Magazzino tests covering CRUD, movimenti (atomic $inc with scorta_prima/scorta_dopo in audit trail), RBAC (_WRITE_ROLES={admin,produzione,contabilita}, _MOV_ROLES={admin,produzione,logistica}), allarmi aggregate, dashboard KPI magazzino_allarmi, and audit log entries (azione='CREATE|CARICO|SCARICO|RETTIFICA', entita='magazzino'). NOTE: audit log schema uses Italian field names 'azione'/'entita'/'entita_id' not 'action'/'entity'. Scarico allows negative stock by design.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no bugs found. Single test-file issue fixed during authoring: audit-log uses Italian field names (azione/entita), not English.
